description: Crustal structure of the Olympic Dam region: Constraints from deep seismic reflection profiles is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Two nearly orthogonal deep seismic reflection profiles acquired in the northern Stuart Shelf, and centred on the Olympic Dam Fe oxide Cu-U-Au deposit, clearly image the cover successions and the structure of the cratonic basement around the deposit. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are AU-SA, Earth Sciences, PowerPoint, Published_External, geochemistry. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
